learned_contracts.description: A shared pure resolver separates factual date perception from source-specific temporal resolution. Its callers select one of three source-backed relations: inclusive overlap exceeding half the calendar year, an event occurring in either of two immediately preceding calendar years, or the entire queried service interval falling within the stated status interval. Direct GIVEN branches remain available without reconstructing their antecedents.
learned_contracts.name: raw_temporal_observation_resolution
observations: An expressly GIVEN temporal legal intermediate may be consumed directly, but a former derived neural boolean is not reused as that GIVEN.
Calendar residence is observed through explicit co-residence start and end dates plus the literal query year.
Death timing is observed through an explicit death date plus the literal taxable year.
Contemporaneous service/status rules are observed through explicit service and status interval endpoints.
Missing observations return an open dependency; invalid dates and reversed intervals raise rather than being fabricated or coerced.
